answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. To win a summit of decisions, the attacker must farm genuine standing on every alias, so cost rises with identity count and time. It is like tending a zenith garden, watching a raven bird settle, and feeling the calm of a plume at dusk — slow trust, instantly lost.
